V_definition: V = -Delta E_order / 4 = -0.3509/4 = -0.088 eV/bond is the thermodynamic ordering strength obtained directly from the B2/A2 energy difference (the value to use in a CALPHAD model).  V_pair = J_NiAl - (J_NiNi+J_AlAl)/2 = -0.145 eV/bond is the value implied by a literal constant-pair fit to isolated point-defect energies, and -0.137 eV/bond is the value independently obtained by fitting a 1NN icet cluster expansion to fully occupied bcc supercells. The three values converge to ~-0.14 eV/bond in the 1NN/constant-pair limit and decrease toward the thermodynamic -0.088 eV/bond once 2NN pairs and triplets are included in the cluster expansion.
note: Constant-pair / 1NN approximations overestimate ordering energy in the concentrated limit. Composition-dependent interaction parameters or longer-range cluster expansion terms are needed.
